question: What measure determines the arrangement of the lotus above the fire-offering?
premises: The fire-offering has a specified height.
Half of that height provides a usable measure.
A lotus is to be arranged above the fire-offering.
inference: The lotus above the fire-offering should be arranged using half the height of the fire-offering as its measure.
uncertainties: The precise architectural or ritual form of the lotus element is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should arrange the lotus above the fire-offering using a measure equal to half the height of the fire-offering.
